intro: Build, craft, and fight to stay alive every day.
description:
Alone in the middle of a vast, endless ocean, your only chance of survival is a small wooden raft and a simple hook. With no civilization in sight, every new day is a struggle against hunger, thirst, powerful storms, and the relentless predators that patrol the waters around you.

The sea is both your greatest resource and your greatest threat. Collect floating debris, recover valuable materials, and craft the equipment you need to stay alive. Expand your fragile raft piece by piece into a dependable floating shelter, then set out to explore distant tropical islands and the mysterious depths in search of rare resources and long-forgotten secrets.

Key Features:
• Build, repair, and upgrade your raft into a sturdy floating shelter
• Craft tools, weapons, equipment, and other survival essentials
• Gather drifting resources using your hook and make every item count
• Fish, cook food, and purify seawater to stay alive
• Explore mysterious islands and underwater locations filled with valuable resources
• Defend yourself against sharks and other dangers of the open ocean

Will you build a thriving home on the sea, or will the endless waves bring your journey to an end?
The ocean is filled with adventure, hidden treasures, and constant danger. Keep building, exploring, and surviving as long as you can in this unforgiving world.
